name: dlead-new-lead-90-day-plan
description: Builds a New Design Lead 90-Day Plan with weeks 1 to 4 to listen, weeks 5 to 8 for one visible win and weeks 9 to 12 to set the rhythm, plus what you stop doing as an IC and the questions to ask your manager.
